name: unctad-digital-government
description: Official plugin marketplace for UNCTAD Digital Government Tools — eRegistrations platform, BPA service development, government procedure reform, and digital public services

plugins.name: bpa-mcp
plugins.description: Install the BPA MCP server and register eRegistrations instance profiles (Nigeria, Jamaica, Lesotho, El Salvador, Kenya, Cuba, Colombia, Gambia, Bhutan). Install this first — all other plugins depend on it. Requires: `uv tool install mcp-eregistrations-bpa`.

plugins.name: service-documentation
plugins.description: Generate citizen-facing HTML service manuals (single and batch) and export structured Excel documentation covering fields, determinants, roles, bots, costs, and document requirements.

plugins.name: service-testing
plugins.description: Validate BPA service configuration across 4 test suites, score against UNCTAD quality standards (0–100), and snapshot services for regression testing.

plugins.name: service-builder
plugins.description: Design and build new eRegistrations services from scratch. Guides through form design, determinant configuration, role assignment, and registration linking. Includes service-architect agent.

plugins.name: service-migration
plugins.description: Copy BPA services between instances (e.g., staging to production, or Jamaica to Lesotho) with dry-run validation and post-migration verification. Includes diff tool for cross-instance auditing.

plugins.name: bpa-debug
plugins.description: Scan, investigate, and fix BPA service configuration issues. Autonomous debug agent provides dependency-ordered fix plans with verification and rollback.

plugins.name: role-configurator
plugins.description: Design and configure multi-agency role structures and processing workflows. Supports single-agency, two-stage approval, and complex multi-track patterns. Includes workflow-designer agent.

plugins.name: institution-setup
plugins.description: Configure institutions and assign them to registrations and roles. Interactive wizard for fresh country deployments. Includes deployment-configurator agent for full-instance setup.

plugins.name: bot-mappings
plugins.description: Create and manage BPA bot integrations and field mappings. AI-powered mapping suggestions, health summaries, validation, and atomic bulk replacement.

plugins.name: workflow-manager
plugins.description: Discover, execute, and manage BPA workflow orchestrations with dry-run validation, interactive step-by-step execution, retry from failure, and rollback.

plugins.name: notification-designer
plugins.description: Design email, SMS, and push notification templates for BPA service status changes. Gap analysis, variable reference, and multilingual guidance.

plugins.name: classification-manager
plugins.description: Create, manage, and export BPA classification catalogs. Bulk operations, ISO country code application, and CSV export.

plugins.name: data-import
plugins.description: Import bulk data into BPA from CSV or Excel: classification catalogs, document requirements, and cost structures. Idempotent with duplicate detection and error reporting.

plugins.name: print-document-builder
plugins.description: Design and manage print documents (certificates, licenses, permits). Template-based creation, component ordering, revision history, and rollback.
